lines.en: I walk carefully, my back straight.
The sword in my hand is a little heavy.
I follow the river upstream.
Purple hair stuck to my temple, damp.
My strides are short and quick.
Wet clay makes my boots slip.
I detour around a flock of noisy birds.

lines.zh: 没有人教我怎么走，我自己学
lines.en: Nobody taught me how to walk this; I learned.
I fasten the buttons of my coat.
The wind is strong; I bow my head and go.
I walk and listen behind me.
Sword in hand, still sheathed.

lines.zh: 我坐在石头上，脚够不到地
lines.en: I sit on a rock, feet not reaching the ground.

lines.zh: 我在磨剑刃，用一块平石
lines.en: I hone my blade on a flat stone.
Boys my age should be at school.
I hug the sword to my chest.
I count the rations left.
A sound far off; I look up.
My ki is faint, but it is there.
I rub my hands; it is cold.

lines.zh: 我把散开的头发扎起来
lines.en: I tie back my loosened hair.

lines.zh: 我在看一只蚂蚁搬东西
lines.en: I watch an ant carry something.
My legs went numb; I shift.
I am not good at resting.

lines.zh: 我在想母亲今晚做什么菜
lines.en: I wonder what my mother would cook tonight.
I yawn, very quietly.
I look up, my hand still on the sword.
You are so tall I have to look up.
I do not know you, but I am not afraid.
I move the sword behind me.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像在同情
lines.en: You look at me as if you pity me.
I do not need pity.
Can you take me away from here?

lines.zh: 我问你一句话，你答不答
lines.en: I have one question; will you answer?

lines.zh: 我站直，尽量显得高一点
lines.en: I straighten, trying to look taller.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和烟的味道
lines.en: You smell of iron and smoke.
I tuck my hair behind my ear.
I study your face carefully.

lines.zh: 你是不是也失去了什么
lines.en: Have you lost something too?

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人挡我前面
lines.en: I dislike people standing in front of me.
My mouth moves; that counts as a smile.
You speak first.
The pain makes me gasp.
I step back, guarding my arm.
Blood seeps from the back of my hand.
I clench my teeth; I do not cry.
It was heavier than I expected.
I press a hand to the wound.
I can still hold the sword.
My legs are shaking.
I draw a sharp cold breath.
Do not mind me; I am fine.
May I take it? Truly?
My mother made something like this.
Let me smell it first.
I eat slowly to keep some.
Are you not eating?
I split it in two.
Something warm would be nice.
You saw me swallow.
Thank you; I will remember.
The bump pushes me back half a step.
I grip the sword so it is not knocked.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我肩膀发麻
lines.en: That numbed my shoulder.
We are both in a hurry, then.
I make a small detour.
I am not angry.
Dust gets in my eyes.
Steady, do not fall.
I do not understand these things yet.
I need to survive first.
Do not bring it up; I blush.

lines.zh: 我连明天在哪都不知道
lines.en: I do not know where I will be tomorrow.
A comrade is enough.
Will you walk a stretch with me?
I hold the sword tighter.
Such words can wait.
I do not want anyone worrying about me.
Let us promise nothing.
I pick it up and wipe it clean.
Can I use this?
I slide it into a side pocket.
It was dropped on the road; I took it.
Too heavy; I cannot carry it.
I should ask who dropped it.
I set it on the stone.
I glance around while picking it up.
This looks like my mother's jewelry.
I keep half and give half back.
I have drawn the sword.
Your hand moved; I saw it.
I may lose, but I will fight.
Half a step back, find an angle.
My ki blasts are small but accurate.
I will not shout; shouting shakes me.
I fix on your knees.
I cannot lose this one.
You hurt someone; I will stop you.
My sword hand is sweating.
There is a line at your feet; do not cross.
I will not strike unseen; I warn you.
I come from the side.
You are stronger; I know that.
I will keep watching you.
Come; I am ready.
I wait for you to swing.
You step in; I give half a step.
I do not have much ki left.
Your movements have a pattern.
I count the gaps between your breaths.
The sword is heavy; I get one swing.
When you turn, I circle.
I am behind the stones.
Your feet are in the mud.
I am patient; I wear you down.
A ki blast seals the left.

lines.zh: 你的影子变短了，中午了
lines.en: Your shadow shortened; it is noon.
I move along the wall.
One more step and I retreat.
I know what you are waiting for.
I will not charge first.
Sweat makes the hilt slip.
I watch you from the corner of my eye.
I bring the sword down two-handed.
That swing went wide.
I strike with the flat of the blade.
I jump to reach your waist.
Ki runs along the blade.
You parried; I disengage and reset.
I kick your shin.

lines.zh: 我喊了一声，给自己壮胆
lines.en: I shout to steady my own nerve.
The tip grazes your sleeve.
I raise an arm to guard my head.
That one landed.
Panting, I still press on.
I turn and add another cut.
The blade sticks; I pull.
My knees bend as I land.
The sword is still in my hand.
Where is this? I do not know it.
First I push the hair from my eyes.
The wind smells of metal.
I stand a long while before moving.
My back feels cold.
I hear my own heart.
Nobody will come looking for me.
I count to ten before I dare walk.
Soil got into my shoes.
I slap the dust off my coat.
I have not seen trees like these.
I look up; the sky is bright.
Alone again.
I fasten the scabbard.
The air smells of turned soil.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，等心跳慢下来
lines.en: I stand still, waiting for my heart to slow.
Flame climbs my sleeve.
I fell from a height; my foot hurts.
The water closed over my head.
The blast knocks me flat.
Something sticks in my side.
That force slipped past my ki.
Too hungry to grip the sword.
The current freezes me for a moment.
I cannot see anything anymore.
